ev.q: In 2005, approximately one fourth of all adults reported participating in any leisure-time strengthening activity
The percentage of adults who engaged in these activities decreased with age, from 37% among persons aged 18--24 years to 10%
In 2005, approximately one fourth of all adults reported participating in any leisure-time strengthening activity
Men were more likely than women to engage in leisure-time strengthening activities.
Data are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized population.
